## What is it?
RAP, or the Research Administration Platform, is a platform on which you can write a DMP and receive feedback from a data steward. For some faculties, you can also use RAP to prepare your documents for ethical review. RAP is **currently** (December 2026) only in use for ACTA and the Faculty of Behavioural and Movement Sciences, other faculties will follow in 2027.
